name: Shopify Signup → New Patient
description: Sends the welcome email to a customer who just signed up in Shopify. Called by the portal's /api/webhooks/shopify/customers-create route, which verifies the Shopify signature and creates the patient record first, then posts { patientId, email, firstName, lastName, shopifyCustomerId } here.

steps.name: Send welcome email
steps.subject: Welcome to Quity, {{event.payload.body.firstName}}
steps.html:
Hi {{event.payload.body.firstName}},

Thanks for signing up with Quity. Your account is set up and we’ll be in touch with your next steps shortly.

— The Quity team
steps.text:
Hi {{event.payload.body.firstName}},

Thanks for signing up with Quity. Your account is set up and we'll be in touch with your next steps shortly.

— The Quity team

steps.name: Log signup on patient timeline
steps.title: Created from Shopify signup
steps.description: Shopify customer {{event.payload.body.shopifyCustomerId}} signed up; patient record and welcome email created automatically.
